lastCompletedStory.title: Parse the per-story behavioral oracle from a PRD story

nextStoryContext: US-001 delivered parseOracleDirectives (src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts). The function returns CriterionOracle[] (criterionIndex + OracleDirective) for criteria carrying [oracle: ...] suffixes; criteria without an oracle are silently skipped. The regex uses a greedy leading .* to anchor to the LAST [oracle:] occurrence in the string (important: criterion prose can contain example [oracle: ...] text). OracleDirective is a discriminated union: named-command (command), file-assert (command), reviewer-judgment, tmux-pty (toolName + artifactRef), no-oracle (raw). US-002 (driving + asserting) can import directly from src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure parser using only TypeScript built-ins and regex. No external library exercised.
